column1: # The column that matters is keyed_on: what the scan is keyed on, and therefore what spelling
# evades it. This is the register that would have caught 'the guard keyed on the substring slope
#   classified mechanically (module docstring and comments stripped first, so prose about
#   'reading' does not count), every file in exactly one bucket:
#   All 61 files get a row. The 48 non-scanners carry population 0 and are marked '— none —' so
#   that no guard is outside the freeze; only the 13 scanners carry a coverage analysis.
# DENOMINATOR — per guard: population = files (or symbols) the guard's DECLARED domain resolves to
# at this HEAD; matched = how many of those the guard's key can actually reach. coverage_pct is
# matched/population. A guard at 100% file coverage can still be weakly keyed — see
# test_cited_paths_exist.py, where every file is reached but the exposure is per-token.
# ── AMENDMENT, after the guard wave. Three cells in this register were WRONG. ─────────────
# A frozen enumeration freezes the LIST OF THINGS TO CHECK. It cannot freeze a measurement that
# was mis-measured, and refusing to correct one would make this file the thing it exists to
# prevent. What changed, and how each was caught:
#      The two figures were TRANSPOSED: 23 is the size of the COMPLEMENT, the modules the guard
#      does not reach. Recomputed mechanically off ATOM-COVERAGE.md code spans against
#      reference-impl/*.py: 44 modules, 21 named, 23 not. Confirmed twice, independently, by the
#      agent that rewrote the guard and by the wave lead.
#   2. test_skill_integrity.py keyed_on: the `f"def {node}("` SUBSTRING symbol check does not
#      exist. It was retired at 028e900 and survives only as a comment at line 84 explaining why.
#      This register was written from that comment as though it described live code.
#   3. test_cited_paths_exist.py keyed_on: bare-prose paths ARE collected. The BARE token family
#      landed at 028e900 (line 101 of the guard at 23bceef). The cell described the recogniser as
# The common cause is worth more than the three fixes: this file says FROZEN at HEAD 0cdd5b1, but
# two of its keyed_on cells describe guards that 028e900 had ALREADY repaired. The enumeration was
# frozen against a reading of the tree that was older than the tree. Briefs written from it sent
# two agents to fix holes that were already closed — both of them said so with evidence and
# refused to comply, which is the only reason this is an amendment and not a regression.
# FREEZE RULE: this row list is final — one row per guard file at this HEAD. Later waves may
# correct a population/matched figure or sharpen a note, but may not add or remove a guard row.
# A guard added after this HEAD goes to OPEN-ITEMS.md.
